$comment: D-CSUBSET-ATOMIC-RMW: runtime witness for the C11/C23 §7.17.7 read-modify-write family across the legs, RUN on BOTH the baseline (debug) AND the `release` (shippedPipeline) arm. 21 distinct non-42 exits cover fetch_add/_sub/_or/_and/_xor (each checking BOTH the OLD value returned and the value left stored — returning `new` would still exit 42 on some arms alone), atomic_exchange, compare_exchange_strong in BOTH outcomes (including the failure path writing the OBSERVED value back through `expected`, the half a positional pass-through silently drops), compare_exchange_weak, and the explicit-order spellings. The family is a HIR→MIR composition over the already-shipped MirOpcode::AtomicCas — NO new MIR op, NO new mnemonic slot — so the two realizations it must agree across are x86-64 `lock cmpxchg` (one locked op) and arm64's REAL CFG LL/SC retry loop over ldaxr/stlxr. An x86-only witness would say nothing about the exclusive-pair path where D-LIR-LLSC-SPILL-EXCLUSION's hazard lives, which is why every leg runs. ANTI-FOLD: every object is a mutable global (runtime-opaque); the atomic ops carry hasSideEffects + opcodeClobbersMemory so the `release` arm proves the family survives Mem2Reg/CSE/LICM/DCE/Inlining un-elided (an elided RMW → a wrong exit). exit = 42.
